'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Russia]]n [[airstrike]] kills eight people and injures twelve others in [[Desna, Chernihiv Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-air-strike-kills-eight-northern-ukraine-emergency-service-2022-05-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two [[Tehrik-i-Taliban]] commanders are killed in a [[shootout]] with [[Pakistan]]i security forces in [[North Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-pakistan-taliban-peshawar-c51441a75c61273f15180ee427f886c4 (AP)]
*[[2022 Tripoli clashes]]
**Heavy fighting breaks out in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]], forcing [[Prime Minister of Libya|Prime Minister]] [[Fathi Bashagha]] to flee the capital. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-government-and-politics-libya-tripoli-6993f7569491e04d46d50e37e7e5d612 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Allianz]]'s American asset management unit pleads guilty to criminal [[securities fraud]] and agrees to pay $5.8 billion to those who have been misled about the risk of investing in some hedge funds that collapsed [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic|with the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic]], in addition to more than $1 billion to the [[Securities and Exchange Commission]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-05-17/allianz-global-ex-investment-officer-tournant-charged-with-fraud (Bloomberg)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/allianz-pay-6-bln-over-structured-alpha-fraud-fund-manager-charged-2022-05-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine people are killed during an explosion caused by a [[gas leak]] at a primary school and a store in [[Kano (city)|Kano]], [[Nigeria]]. '''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**Another four cases of [[monkeypox]] are confirmed by the [[UK Health Security Agency]], bringing the total number recorded in the current outbreak to seven. Notably, these new cases appear to be the result of [[community transmission]], with no known links to previous cases. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-61470940 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[International sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis]]
**The [[United States]] lifts some [[economic sanction]]s on [[Venezuela]], including allowing the [[Chevron Corporation]] to negotiate its license with the Venezuelan [[PDVSA]] [[state-owned enterprise|state-owned]] [[oil]] company and removing the names of some Venezuelan officials from a [[Government of the United States|United States government]] list of sanctioned individuals. [https://apnews.com/article/biden-venezuela-caribbean-united-states-f73616e984ab38e049c4881782a04959 (AP)]
